hypotheses_not_observed: The XFOIL primer says a viscous Newton step starts from the previous solution and that a large alpha change can fail. That mechanism is consistent with starting at -40 deg, but the retained ledger does not isolate order from angle, Reynolds, or Mach.
NACA2412's timeout is not evidence that a particular angle failed.
A synthetic constant-coefficient solve that stops before the terminal psi does not locate the queries a real polar would issue.

xfoil_primary_documentation.numerical_behavior: Viscous analysis can fail for excessive angle of attack or Reynolds number that is too low. Newton iteration resumes from the last solution; the primer recommends sequencing alpha gradually.
xfoil_primary_documentation.physical_applicability: The primer does not qualify this rotor, these coordinates, or the retained failed angles.
xfoil_primary_documentation.scope: Subsonic isolated airfoils, viscous analysis with limited trailing-edge separation and a Karman-Tsien compressibility correction.

xfoil_request_order.adapter_initialization: PLOP, G F, LOAD, PANE when repanel is true, OPER, TYPE 1, VISC, MACH, VPAR N, XTR, ITER, PACC, then one ALFA command per requested angle in the original order. The adapter does not send INIT.
xfoil_request_order.historical_first_cell: Mach 0, Reynolds minimum, alpha ascending from the most negative grid angle

recommended_experiment.acceptance: Every requested point is usable and the cell usable fraction is 1. No point is discarded, clamped, or replaced. Coordinate hashes match the catalog.
recommended_experiment.can_establish: Whether this declared eight-cell grid, descending order, kinematic Mach and Reynolds endpoints, and one-script-per-cell execution produce a complete usable ledger.
recommended_experiment.cannot_establish: A genuine two-profile BEM comparison. A failure establishes failure of this grid, sequencing, and execution configuration only. It does not establish infeasibility of the correlated kinematic image, the actual solver path, either profile, or the project. Differences from PR #97 cannot be attributed only to sequencing because the Mach grid also changes. Starting at the padded +32 deg grid angle does not execute the +30.65875 deg conditional first query.
recommended_experiment.capture: XfoilProvider.generate(capture_dir=...) writes raw stdout, stderr, and polar bytes before temporary-directory cleanup, including timeout, decode failure, and exception paths. Replacement-decoded diagnostic text is not those raw bytes. Executable identity is the file hash immediately before and after the subprocess call; a missing or changed hash blocks evidence readiness even when the parsed output is usable. Declared source and compiler flags remain an unverified build requirement. Omitting capture_dir preserves the default provider result.
recommended_experiment.cell_execution: run_declared_probe is the enforcement point. It launches at most eight declared cells, one attempt each, and stops before the next cell after a failed cell. The adapter still submits each launched cell as one complete script and does not interrupt that script at the first bad angle. A manifest alone does not enforce these limits, and this diagnostic does not launch the probe.

provider.initialization: Existing adapter script only: PLOP, G F, LOAD, PANE, OPER, TYPE 1, VISC, MACH, VPAR N 9, XTR 1 1, ITER 80, PACC, then ALFA in descending alpha order. No INIT command and no replay of the ascending -40 deg request.
provider.name: xfoil-subprocess

recommended_experiment.serial_order: NACA0012 then NACA2412; within a profile, Mach ascending and Reynolds ascending.
stop_conditions: run_declared_probe stops before the next cell after not_converged, timeout, nonzero exit, malformed output, undecodable output, missing evidence, executable mismatch, persistence failure, or an unexpected exception.
A partial ledger does not authorize continuation.
Do not retry, change ITER, send INIT, clamp, substitute coefficients, or start a BEM call.
The manifest does not launch cells and does not enforce the stop.
